proposal.source: function parseToml(_cap, text) { const hasOwn = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty; const out = Object.create(null); let section = out; for (const raw of text.split(/\r?\n/)) { const line = raw.trim(); if (!line || line.startsWith('#')) continue; if (line.startsWith('[') && line.endsWith(']')) { const name = line.slice(1,-1).trim(); if (!name) throw new Error('invalid section'); if (hasOwn.call(out, name)) { const existing = out[name]; if (existing === null || typeof existing !== 'object') throw new Error('duplicate key'); section = existing; } else { section = Object.create(null); out[name] = section; } continue; } const at = line.indexOf('='); if (at < 1) throw new Error('invalid assignment'); const key = line.slice(0,at).trim(); const value = line.slice(at+1).trim(); if (/^"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"$/.test(value)) section[key] = JSON.parse(value); else if (value === 'true' || value === 'false') section[key] = value === 'true'; else if (/^[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(value)) section[key] = Number(value); else throw new Error('unsupported TOML value'); } return out; }
proposal.description: Parse deterministic flat TOML scalars and one-level tables without effects.
tests: (() => { let threw = false; try { parseToml('name = "x"\n[name]'); } catch (_) { threw = true; } return threw && parseToml('name = "x"').name === 'x'; })()
